pages.observed: Five phone frames 0.0 to 0.8 s. An airport curb scene with a ride app phone card reading Ride requested. A white sensor-roofed car slides in from the left toward an outlined pickup bay. From 0.2 s a caption reads Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver,

Frames 1.0 to 1.8 s. The white sensor-roof car sits in or near the outlined pickup bay at the curb with a red brake lamp glow at its rear. Phone card still reads Ride requested. Caption unchanged. Caption box sits just below the car's wheels.

2.0 to 2.4 s the car holds at the curb bay with brake glow while a small Texas outline locator card fades in at top right. At 2.6 s the picture cuts inside the cabin: windshield, steering wheel, dash screen with a route line and two empty seats, the pickup sign visible outside. The phone card overlay and caption stay on screen over the interior.

Interior view 3.0 to 3.8 s. The steering wheel turns by itself, its rim marker moving clockwise, with both front seats empty. Outside the windshield the pickup sign drifts right and leaves the view. The Texas outline locator card finishes drawing. Caption box overlaps the seat backs.

Interior view 4.0 to 4.8 s is held almost static: wheel turned with its marker at the right, empty seats, pale windshield with only the edge of the pickup sign at right. Texas locator card complete. Phone card still reads Ride requested. Caption unchanged.

5.0 to 5.2 s the empty interior holds and the first caption clears. At 5.4 s the shot cuts to the curb: a large phone card tilted in the foreground with the route map, the white car parked in the bay behind it under the airport pickup sign. The phone still reads Ride requested and Finding a car through 5.8 s. Caption reads the airport included. Locator card shows a ringed dot.

6.0 to 6.8 s, curb close view. The phone route marker reaches the pin and the phone status changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s while the white car sits parked in the bay behind it. The caption the airport included clears by 6.6 s and the composition holds.

7.0 to 7.8 s. New shot: a pale gridded street map lies on a brown plank table outdoors with a February calendar page standing at its upper right corner and three small car pins near the center. The map is mostly static until 7.8 s, when a short blue river line and a curved line start to draw. Caption reads The service began in February.

8.0 to 8.8 s. On the table map the blue river line draws downward through the center and thin grey road lines and a faint ring road appear around the three car pins. The Texas locator card fades out. February calendar page stays standing at the upper right of the map. Caption unchanged.

9.0 to 9.2 s the wide map holds and the caption clears. At 9.4 s a closer framing of the map fills most of the frame. At 9.6 s a tag reading 60 square miles, Limited area lands near the top and a dark outline stroke starts at the upper left. The February calendar slides in from the lower right and settles tilted on the map corner at 9.8 s. Caption reads in a limited area of sixty square miles.

10.0 to 10.8 s. The dark service-area outline traces from the upper left across the top under the 60 square miles tag and turns down the right side toward the car pins. The February calendar page shifts to the lower left corner of the map. Caption holds in a limited area of sixty square miles.

11.0 to 11.8 s. The dark outline wraps around the car pins and closes into an irregular polygon by 11.2 s, then a grey fill shades the enclosed limited area, which holds with all three pins inside. The 60 square miles tag sits above it and the February page at lower left. Caption holds.

12.0 to 12.8 s. The closed, shaded limited-area polygon holds on the table map with the three pins inside; the lower-left pin shows a tiny white car shape and the pins shift slightly. The caption clears at 12.8 s. Every frame on this page is still the map shot; no creek or water appears yet.

13.0 s is still the map. At 13.2 s a cut to a creek: brown water fills the lower frame, a white sensor-roof car sits in it with its lower body under the water and a faint reflection, live oaks on the far bank, rounded limestone ledge steps at the right edge with a thin curved pale line running down from them, and faint rain streaks. The far edge of the water, where it meets the bank under the trees, is a straight horizontal line across the full frame width with a slightly lighter strip just below it. No rectangular box is visible around the ledge steps at this sample size. The car moves little across 13.2 to 13.8 s. Caption: In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.

14.0 to 14.8 s, same creek shot held. The white car sits half submerged in the far part of the water and drifts slightly left, with a small brown splash at its rear right from 14.6 s. A pale tan band runs straight and horizontal across the full frame width along the far edge of the water under the bank, with a straight lower boundary line visible below it, most clearly at 14.0 s. The right-edge ledge steps and the thin curved line hold. The caption box sits over the water just below the car.

15.0 to 15.2 s the wide creek shot continues: the car drifts left with a brown wake trailing to the right. At 15.4 s the framing moves closer: trees larger, distant buildings gone, ledge steps out of frame. The car tilts nose down, sinks to the windows and moves left 15.4 to 15.8 s with a trailing wake. In every frame a pale tan band runs straight and horizontal across the full width between the far bank and the darker brown water, with straight upper and lower boundaries. Caption holds.

16.0 to 16.8 s, closer creek shot. The white car is sunk to its roofline, empty seat backs visible through the glass, and it drifts slightly left while a pale wake curve and small tan floating pieces trail to its right. Along the far bank a pale tan band of water runs straight and horizontal across the entire frame width, bounded by straight horizontal lines above and below. Caption box sits on the water below the car.

17.0 to 17.4 s the creek shot ends with the roof-deep car drifting left until it is partly outside the left edge, a wake and floating pieces behind it, and a jagged pale vertical line descending from the wake into the water. The pale tan band along the far bank stays straight and horizontal across the full width. At 17.6 s a cut to a flooded residential street: beige houses, a live oak, a green street sign, a white sensor-roof car standing in brown water with a reflection, a dark grey rounded shape at the right edge, and a pale tiled sidewalk filling the lower third. Disclosure reads Illustration. Another car, earlier in April. No caption 17.4 to 17.8 s.

18.0 to 18.8 s on the flooded street. The white car moves right toward the center while the brown water rises on its body, covering the lower half of the wheels by 18.8 s, with a reflection below. A dark grey shape at the right edge exits by 18.4 s. Sidewalk tiles fill the lower frame. Caption reads Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.

19.0 to 19.8 s. The white car sits stopped at the center of the flooded street with water over its wheels to the lower doors. At 19.6 s and 19.8 s small amber lamps glow at the front and rear corners of the car. Street, houses and sidewalk hold. Caption unchanged.

20.0 to 20.8 s. A closer framing of the stopped white car in floodwater with the background softened: empty headrests visible through the windows, water at the lower doors and a reflection below. Amber corner lamps glow at 20.2 and 20.4 s, are off at 20.6 s and glow at the rear at 20.8 s. Caption unchanged.

21.0 to 21.8 s. The same close view of the stopped white car in floodwater holds, with a slight sideways drift of the framing. Amber lamps at the car's front and rear glow and dim across the samples. Empty headrests visible, water at lower doors, reflection below. Caption unchanged.

22.0 s still shows the stopped car in floodwater. At 22.2 s the shot cuts to an olive wall over a brown desk with a cream card titled Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall, entering from the right with a navy pen at its corner. The card slides further onto the desk and at 22.8 s field text begins writing in (Reca, Sof). Caption reads Waymo filed a software recall. Disclosure returns to Generic car with no brand mark.

23.0 to 23.8 s. The Federal recall record card settles on the desk and its fields type in: Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791 by 23.6 s, with a typing cursor visible. The pen rests at the card's lower right corner. Caption reads Waymo filed a software recall.

24.0 to 24.4 s the completed record card holds (Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791) and the caption clears. At 24.6 s a new framing puts the card at top with a grid of faint empty car-icon slots below and the end of a stamp handle at the right edge. At 24.8 s three white car icons have filled the top-left of the grid. Caption reads that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

25.0 to 25.8 s. The grid of small white car icons fills row by row, from about one row to five rows of ten. A forearm in a blue sleeve enters from the right holding a wooden rubber stamp and moves it over the card to just above the Recall type row by 25.8 s. Caption holds.

26.0 to 26.8 s. A hand in a blue sleeve lowers a wooden stamp onto the upper part of the record card; at 26.8 s an amber outlined impression beginning with So shows under it. A counter tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in at 26.4 s and settles between the card and the full five-row car-icon grid. Caption holds.

27.0 to 27.8 s. The hand lifts the wooden stamp off and exits right, leaving an amber Software recall impression on the card's header. The completed card, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full car-icon grid hold through 27.8 s. Caption holds.

28.0 to 28.2 s the stamped record scene holds. At 28.4 s a cut to a wide two-lane road with a street lamp, trees and a distant skyline; a white sensor-roof car enters from the left and moves right. At 28.8 s a faint card fades in above the road with the recall sentence: The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways. No standing water is visible on the road yet. Caption reads The recall says the software may let a car slow,

29.0 to 29.8 s. The recall sentence card is fully legible above the road. The white car runs right along the lane with short speed lines behind it while the lamp, skyline and lane dashes scroll left; the street lamp leaves the frame by 29.4 s. No standing water visible on the road yet. Caption holds.

30.0 to 30.8 s. The car keeps running right along the lane with the scenery scrolling left; a new street lamp and tree enter from the right. Its red brake lamp glows at 30.6 and 30.8 s. At 30.8 s the edge of a pale grey water shape appears at the right side of the road ahead of the car. Sentence card and caption hold.

31.0 to 31.8 s. A pale grey lens-shaped water patch lies on the road at the right edge, its lower half hidden behind the caption box. The white car approaches it with its red brake lamp lit 31.0 to 31.4 s while the scenery scroll slows; the brake glow is not visible at 31.6 and 31.8 s. The car has not reached the water by 31.8 s.

32.0 to 32.6 s the wide lane shot holds with the car advancing slowly toward the pale grey water patch at the right; it does not reach the patch on screen. Caption clears by 32.6 s. At 32.8 s the shot cuts to a close side view of the car on the lane under the recall sentence card, with a thin wavy pale line along the road at its wheels. No caption at 32.6 to 32.8 s.

33.0 to 33.8 s, close side view. The white car stays near center on the dark lane while a pale grey standing-water edge slides in from the right and approaches the front wheel, not yet touching it by 33.8 s. A thin wavy pale line runs under the wheels. Sentence card above. Caption reads then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

34.0 to 34.8 s, close side view. The pale grey standing-water sheet now reaches the car's front wheel, and by 34.8 s the front wheel is in it with small pale splash lines. At 34.2 s the word may in the recall sentence card is highlighted amber and stays lit. Caption holds.

35.0 to 35.8 s. The car's front half is in the grey standing-water sheet; pale wake lines fan out behind the front wheel and a darker reflection patch shows in the water. The amber may highlight stays lit on the sentence card. Caption holds. The wake partly runs behind the caption box edge.

36.0 to 36.8 s. The car now stands with both wheels in the grey standing-water sheet, wake lines and a reflection under it, a red tail lamp at the rear. The may highlight stays lit. The caption clears at 36.6 s and the result holds without a caption through 36.8 s.

37.0 to 37.8 s. Cut back to the stamped Federal recall record card on the desk, closer than before. A new Remedy row types in below the units field and reads The remedy is currently under development. by 37.6 s, then the row shades pale amber. No pen visible on this page. Caption reads The federal record says the remedy is currently under development.

38.0 to 38.8 s. With the remedy row highlighted, a hand in a blue sleeve slides a pen in from the right; its tip comes to rest beside the words under development by 38.6 s and holds. Caption unchanged.

39.0 to 39.8 s. The pen arm keeps its tip at the remedy text while a second forearm, also in a blue sleeve and also entering from the right edge, brings a wooden stamp in from the lower right and lowers it onto the remedy row below the text. The framing pushes slightly closer from 39.2 s. No stamp impression is visible yet on this page. Caption unchanged.

40.0 to 40.8 s. The wooden stamp presses on the remedy row, then lifts and slides right, leaving an amber Under development impression on the row by 40.6 s; the stamp arm withdraws toward the lower right while the pen arm stays at the text. Caption unchanged.

41.0 to 41.4 s both arms withdraw from the stamped card, which now shows the Under development impression on its remedy row; caption clears at 41.2 s. At 41.6 s a cut to a row of four white sensor-roof cars on a wet lot with a wire overhead carrying a small Vehicle maps card and an April calendar page. At 41.8 s a tag sliding in from the left reads ...ther limits. Caption reads As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,

42.0 to 42.8 s. A tag reading Weather limits, tightened, with a rain cloud icon, slides along the overhead wire from the left and pins above the row of four parked white cars. The Vehicle maps card and April page hang on the right of the wire. Cars hold. Caption holds.

43.0 to 43.8 s. The parked row of four white cars holds under the wire. The Weather limits, tightened tag drifts slightly right and tilts a little at 43.8 s; the Vehicle maps card and April page hold. No check marks on the cars yet. Caption holds.

44.0 to 44.8 s. The same lot composition holds: four parked white cars, the Weather limits tag swaying slightly on the wire, the Vehicle maps card and April page unchanged. No new event; no check marks on the cars. Caption holds.

45.0 to 45.4 s the wide lot holds and the caption clears. At 45.6 s a cut to a closer, lower view: the lead white car large at left with the row receding right, the Weather limits tag, Vehicle maps card and April page larger above. No check marks on any car yet. Caption at 45.8 s reads and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

46.0 to 46.8 s. Circular check mark badges pop up above the cars from left to right: the lead car first at 46.0 s, then the second at 46.4 s, the third at 46.6 s and a fourth small one at 46.8 s. Tag, map card and April page hold above. Caption reads and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

47.0 to 47.8 s. All four visible cars carry check mark badges. A small check badge appears on the Vehicle maps card at 47.2 to 47.4 s with tiny text reading updated. The April calendar page hangs with no day number visible yet. Caption holds.
48.0 to 48.6 s the checked row, tag, map card and April page hold. At 48.8 s the calendar page has flipped to show a large 20 under the April header. Caption holds.
49.0 to 49.8 s. The calendar now reads April 20, the flipped sheet settling behind it. The checked car row, Weather limits tag and checked Vehicle maps card hold. The caption clears at 49.8 s.

50.0 to 50.8 s. Cut back to the airport pickup curb, the same composition as the opening: the white sensor-roof car parked in the outlined bay, the phone card reading Arriving. Disclosure reads Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. The car holds; no door movement is visible yet. Caption reads So the airport ride is open,

51.0 to 51.8 s. The white car parked in the curb bay opens its rear side door: from 51.2 s a dark doorway appears with a tan door panel swung out, wider by 51.6 to 51.8 s. The door is small at this framing. Phone card reads Arriving. Caption holds.

52.0 to 52.6 s the curb view holds with the car's rear door open; caption clears at 52.6 s. At 52.8 s a new framing shows the open-door car at center right, a small phone leaning on the bench, and a small Federal recall record card in the lower foreground on the road, its remedy row reading The remedy is currently under development with an amber stamp. The card is small at this sample size.

53.0 to 53.8 s. A small tilted Federal recall record card on the roadway slides toward center and straightens below the parked open-door car. Its remedy row reads The remedy is currently under development with a small amber stamp; the card text is small at this phone sample size. A small phone leans on the bench. Caption reads and the federal record lists the flood remedy.

54.0 to 54.8 s. The record card enlarges into the foreground, becoming legible: Federal recall record, Remedy, The remedy is currently under development, with an amber Under development stamp. Its top edge rises to the car's wheel line and slightly overlaps the bottom of the car and bay, then shifts left by 54.6 s. The open-door car holds behind it. Caption holds.

55.0 to 55.8 s. The foreground record card with the remedy row reading The remedy is currently under development and its amber stamp holds beneath the open-door car at the curb, with only a slight sideways drift of the framing. The card's top edge overlaps the car's lower body. Caption holds.

56.0 to 56.2 s the curb-and-card frame holds and the caption clears. At 56.4 s a split framing: the top half shows the curb with the white car, rear door open, bench and suitcase under the pickup sign; the bottom half is a brown desk carrying the Federal recall record card with its remedy row and Under development stamp, beside a small phone showing a route and Arriving. Caption at 56.6 s reads as currently under development.

57.0 to 57.8 s. The split frame holds: the open-door white car at the curb above, the recall card and Arriving phone on the desk below. A dark underline draws left to right beneath the remedy sentence. The car's rear door moves slightly between samples. Caption reads as currently under development.

58.0 to 58.4 s the split close holds (open-door car above, underlined remedy card and phone below); the caption clears after 58.0 s and the pair holds about 0.4 s without caption. At 58.6 s a cut to the dark credits card: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, sources Waymo October 14th, NHTSA recall 26E026, Texas Public Radio May 10th and 13th, plus illustration, map and music credits.

59.0 to 59.8 s. The dark credits card holds unchanged: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com, then sources (Waymo October 14th, NHTSA recall 26E026, Texas Public Radio May 10th and 13th), illustration, map and music credits.
60.0 to 60.8 s. The same dark credits card holds without change: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration, map and music credits.
61.0 to 61.8 s. The dark credits card continues unchanged with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL, source list and music credit.
62.0 to 62.8 s. The dark credits card holds unchanged: flag, wordmark, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration note, map note reading Service area outline is editorial, and music credit.

63.0 to 63.433 s, four samples including the final phone frame 1903. The dark credits card holds unchanged to the end: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration, map and music credits.

0.0 to 0.8 s, option b. Same airport curb opening: a white sensor-roof car slides in from the left toward the outlined bay under the pickup sign, the phone card reads Ride requested, Finding a car. Caption from 0.2 s: Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver,
1.0 to 1.8 s, option b. The white car sits in the outlined curb bay with a red brake lamp glow at its rear, shifting slightly between samples. Phone card still reads Ride requested. Caption holds.

2.0 to 2.4 s, option b. The car holds in the bay with brake glow while the Texas locator card fades in. At 2.6 s a cut inside the cabin: windshield with the pickup sign, steering wheel, dash route screen and two empty seats; the route marker on the dash screen advances by 2.8 s. Caption holds.

3.0 to 3.8 s, option b. Inside the cabin the steering wheel turns by itself, its rim marker moving clockwise, with both seats empty; the pickup sign slides right out of the windshield view and the Texas locator outline completes. Caption holds over the seat backs.

4.0 to 4.8 s, option b. The interior view holds almost unchanged: wheel turned with its rim marker at the right, empty seats, a pale windshield with only the edge of the pickup sign at right, completed Texas outline card. Phone card still reads Ride requested. Caption holds.

5.0 to 5.2 s, option b, the empty interior holds and the caption clears. At 5.4 s a cut to the curb: a large tilted phone with the route map in front of the white car parked in the bay under the pickup sign; the phone still reads Ride requested, Finding a car. Caption reads the airport included. Locator card shows a ringed dot at 5.8 s.

6.0 to 6.8 s, option b. The phone's route marker reaches the pin and the status changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s, while the white car sits parked in the bay. Caption clears by 6.6 s.

7.0 to 7.8 s, option b. Cut to an overhead flat gridded map card on an olive background with three small car pins and a February calendar page at its lower left. The map is still until 7.8 s, when a blue river line and a thin curved road line begin to draw. Caption reads The service began in February.

8.0 to 8.8 s, option b. On the overhead map a blue river line and a second blue line draw downward, and a ring road plus radial road lines appear around the central pins. The Texas locator card fades out. February page stays at lower left. Caption holds.

9.0 to 9.2 s, option b, the overhead map holds and the caption clears. At 9.4 s the framing changes to the same map lying on a brown plank table seen at an angle. At 9.6 s a 60 square miles, Limited area tag lands near the top and a dark outline stroke begins on the left; the February calendar slides in from the right and lands at the lower right by 9.8 s. Caption reads in a limited area of sixty square miles.

10.0 to 10.8 s, option b. The dark service-area outline traces across the top of the table map under the 60 square miles tag and curves down the right side toward the pins. The February page shifts to the lower left. Caption holds.

11.0 to 11.8 s, option b. The dark outline wraps around the three pins and closes into a polygon by 11.2 s, then a grey fill shades the limited area, which holds through 11.8 s. Tag and February page stay. Caption holds.

12.0 to 12.8 s, option b. The shaded limited-area polygon holds on the table map with the pins inside; a small white car shape appears beside the lower-left pin. The caption clears at 12.8 s. All frames on this page are still the map; no creek or water yet.

13.0 s still the table map. At 13.2 s a cut to an overhead creek: a brown water band runs horizontally across the middle, edged top and bottom by pale wavy limestone strips, with round tree canopies on grassy banks. A white car roof with a sensor pod sits at the lower bank edge with a pale curved wake line trailing up and right, and a thin line toward the left. Both water edges are wavy, not straight; no rectangular box or straight seam is visible on the water at this size. The car barely moves across 13.2 to 13.8 s. Caption: In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.

14.0 to 14.8 s, option b. The overhead creek holds; the white car roof sits at the lower bank edge and shifts left then right by small amounts, its pale curved wake line moving with it. Water edges stay wavy, with no straight edge, seam or box visible. Caption holds over the lower bank.

15.0 to 15.2 s, option b, overhead: the car roof shifts left and rotates slightly at the bank edge. At 15.4 s a cut to a ground-level creek: brown water with rain streaks fills the lower two thirds, a white sensor-roof car sits half submerged with a reflection and a wake curving to its right, and a live oak stands on the far bank. Directly under the far-bank grass line a pale tan band of water runs straight and horizontal across the entire frame width, with straight upper and lower boundaries, in all three ground-level samples. Caption holds.

16.0 to 16.8 s, option b. The white car is sunk to its roofline, empty seats visible through the glass, drifting slightly left with a wake curve and small tan floating pieces to its right. A pale tan band of water runs straight and horizontal across the full frame width directly under the far-bank grass line, with straight boundaries above and below, in every sample. Caption holds.

17.0 to 17.4 s, option b. The roof-deep car drifts left until it is cut by the left edge; wake, floating pieces and a jagged pale vertical line remain in the water. The pale tan band under the far bank stays straight and horizontal across the full width. Caption clears at 17.4 s. At 17.6 s a cut to a flooded residential street: beige houses, live oak, green street signs, a white sensor-roof car in brown water with a reflection, a dark grey shape at the right edge, and a tiled sidewalk foreground.

18.0 to 18.8 s, option b. On the flooded street the white car moves right to the center while the brown water rises over its lower wheels; the dark grey shape at the right edge leaves by 18.4 s. Caption reads Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.

19.0 to 19.8 s, option b. The white car sits stopped at the center of the flooded street with water to the lower doors; small amber lamps glow at its front and rear corners at 19.6 and 19.8 s. Caption holds.

20.0 to 20.8 s, option b. Closer framing of the stopped white car in floodwater with a softened background, empty headrests visible, reflection below. Amber corner lamps glow at 20.2 and 20.4 s, dim at 20.6 s and the rear glows at 20.8 s. Caption holds.

21.0 to 21.8 s, option b. The close view of the stopped car in floodwater holds with a slight sideways drift of the framing; the amber lamps at front and rear glow and dim across the samples. Caption holds.

22.0 s still the stopped car. At 22.2 s, option b cuts to an overhead brown desk panel on an olive ground with a cream Federal recall record card sliding in from the right and a navy pen at the lower right. The card moves further onto the desk and field text begins typing at 22.8 s (Reca, Sof). Caption reads Waymo filed a software recall.

23.0 to 23.8 s, option b. The record card settles on the overhead desk and its fields type in: Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791 by 23.6 s, with a typing cursor. Pen at lower right. Caption holds.

24.0 to 24.4 s, option b. The completed card holds and the caption clears. At 24.6 s a new framing shows the card at top and a grid of empty car-icon slots below, a stamp handle edge at the right. At 24.8 s three white car icons fill the top-left slots. Caption reads that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

25.0 to 25.8 s, option b. The car-icon grid fills row by row to about five rows of ten while a forearm in a blue sleeve carries a wooden stamp in from the right and positions it over the card's upper area by 25.8 s. Caption holds.

26.0 to 26.8 s, option b. The hand holds the wooden stamp on the card's header; at 26.8 s an amber impression beginning with So shows beside it. A tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in at 26.4 s and settles between the card and the full car-icon grid. Caption holds.

27.0 to 27.8 s, option b. The stamp lifts and exits right, leaving an amber Software recall impression on the card header. The card, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full car-icon grid hold. Caption holds.

28.0 to 28.2 s, option b, the stamped record scene holds. At 28.4 s a cut to an overhead straight two-lane road with a dashed center line and grass verges; a small white car roof with sensor pod moves up the lane. At 28.8 s a faint card with the recall sentence fades in near the top. No water visible on the road yet. Caption reads The recall says the software may let a car slow,

29.0 to 29.8 s, option b. The recall sentence card is fully legible near the top. The car roof stays near the same screen position while the lane dashes scroll downward, so the car reads as travelling up the road. From 29.2 s a pale grey standing-water shape enters from the top edge across the right lane and grows larger by 29.8 s. Caption holds.

30.0 to 30.8 s, option b. A large pale grey standing-water patch over the right lane slides down from the top toward the car, partly behind the sentence card; the lane dash scroll slows and at 30.8 s two small red brake lamp dots show at the car's rear. The water has not reached the car. Caption holds.

31.0 to 31.8 s, option b. The car roof, its red brake lamps lit, moves slowly up the lane toward the pale grey water patch ahead, which sits partly behind the sentence card. The car has not reached the water by 31.8 s. Caption holds.

32.0 to 32.6 s, option b. Overhead, the braking car creeps toward the pale grey water patch without reaching it; caption clears at 32.6 s. At 32.8 s a cut to a close side view of the white car on the dark lane under the sentence card, a tree and lamp post behind, with a thin wavy pale line along the road at its wheels.

33.0 to 33.8 s, option b. The close side view holds the white car near center while a pale grey standing-water edge slides in from the right toward the front wheel, not yet touching by 33.8 s. Caption reads then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

34.0 to 34.8 s, option b. The grey standing-water sheet reaches the front wheel and the wheel enters it with small splash lines by 34.8 s. At 34.2 s the word may on the sentence card highlights amber and stays lit. Caption holds.

35.0 to 35.8 s, option b. The car's front half is in the grey standing-water sheet; pale wake lines fan out behind the front wheel and a darker reflection shows. The may highlight stays lit. The wake partly runs behind the caption box top edge. Caption holds.

36.0 to 36.8 s, option b. The car stands in the grey water sheet with wake lines and a reflection under it, the may highlight lit. The caption clears at 36.6 s and the result holds without caption to 36.8 s, wake fully visible.
